segments.name: Spintronics
segments.description: Develops and sells spintronic devices including sensors, couplers, memories, and power products for industrial, medical, and military customers.
segments.evidence: We manufacture high-performance spintronic products including sensors and couplers that are used to acquire and transmit data.

revenueModel.text: Customers and distributors pay NVE for spintronic product shipments, and the company also earns revenue from contract research and development.
revenueModel.evidence: We recognize revenue from product sales to customers and distributors when we satisfy our performance obligation, at a point in time, on product shipment or delivery to our customer or distributor as determined by agreed-on shipping terms.
